title: Freddie Slater to make F1 weekend debut with FP1 outings for Audi in Mexico City and Sao Paulo
paragraphs: Audi Development Driver Freddie Slater will get his first taste of Formula 1 race weekend action when he drives for Audi in FP1 in Mexico City and Sao Paulo. The 18-year-old became the first driver to be signed to the German manufacturer's programme earlier this year and dovetailed his duties with a campaign in F3 where he finished runner up with Trident Motorsport. paragraphs: Jak Crawford will take the wheel of Lance Stroll’s AMR26 during FP1 at the Mexico City Grand Prix, marking his fourth on-track appearance of the 2026 season. title: Sergio Perez signs contract extension to remain at the Cadillac Formula 1 Team until at least 2029
paragraphs: Sergio Perez has extended his contract with the Cadillac Formula 1 Team, ensuring the Mexican driver will remain with the American outfit until at least 2029.
